newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Transaero Jan-Aug passenger, cargo loads up.
newsitem.headline: Russia Transaero Jan-Aug passenger, cargo loads up.

text.p: Russia's private Transaero airline passenger traffic and cargo hauling increased sharply in the first eight months on year-ago levels, the company said on Tuesday.
Transaero spokeswoman Natalya Aleksashina told Reuters in an interview that the airline carried 937,000 passengers from January to August, against 693,000 in the same period of 1995.
Transaero hauled 3,700 tonnes of cargo in the first eight months, compared to 1,340 tonnes in the same period of 1995.
Transaero carried 686,000 passengers in January to August on regularly scheduled flights, versus 529,000 passengers during the first eight months last year, she said.
Other passengers were flown by Transaero charter flights.
AO Transaero was established in 1991 and flies to 21 destinations in the former Soviet Union and seven other international destinations.
